notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Stabilizing the End
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We recently took all of Dex' old games over to the Duality Beyond Studios account. While Sirius Online is being taken off sale completely, we decided to take up the opportunity to give AOTFA some last points of love before we move on to our newer games.

Patch 1.1 thus, contains a few Engine updates to allow the game running with more than 1.5GB RAM and not crash in unsupported resolutions. 

We also reduced the game's price to 1,99$, to reflect the age and state of this game.

Feel free to join the Discord and take a look at our newest endeavours: beyond.frontiers and TinyDACHI

- the DualityBeyond Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5: Derelict Ships, Minefields, New Menu, Starmap, and so, so much more...
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

Patch 1.0.5 is finally here after this long delay. Many things have changed and let us start with the much awaited patch notes!

Following things have been done:

[list]
[*] New Weapon Scaling - Shield/Armor and Long Range Weapons[*] Main Menu and Character Creation ahs been completely redone
[*] Updated Damage for all NPCs
[*] Updated T.O.A.St. to ahve slightly better Collision Avoidance
[*] Added Starmap Functionality with Shift+B
[*] Another Update to Loot Timing and strength
[*] ANGEL is back and replaces BRIAN
[*] Tutorial is now completely overhauled and should be way more pleasant to the eyes and better playable.
[*] New Randomized Racetrack in the Tutorial System
[*] Lost Ships can now appear and be found in star systems. Search for a blue Ping on the scanner.
[*] Scanner now pitches Differently depending on rarity. Higher Pitch = Rarer item.
[*] Minefields can now appear in Star Systems.
[*] Story Pacing has been changed slightly with ANGEL.
[*] NPCs now talk less gibberish.
[/list]

Feel free to join the Community Discord here:

[url=https://discord.gg/sbFyqVS]AOTFA Discord[/url]

Next Update - 1.0.6

Regards, Dex

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 is coming next week!
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders!

After the quick succession of patches last week I took some time to go for the things mentioned in the recent review and the constructive criticism, to improve on what is in and what can be made better.

I am still hard working on things like derelict ships, better Story handling and an all new tutorial with subtitles, as well as usable menus.

This was, as you know the old start menu:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34440821/8f44f0c1608833a3cf97863a224ab06d822a9323.jpg[/img]

In 1.0.5, it is replaced with this, a far superior, more readable and usable version.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34440821/09ac23f878feb4f9f10e4494d5308706c167ee87.png[/img]

There are more changes coming along, like an automatic loot tractor beam, removal of manual mining, hidden treasures, minefields that can be weaponized, radiation zones, Epstein Jumpdrive Fields, hazardous zones. I hope I can deliver this Patch somewhere between tuesday and thursday and hope you will definitely like it :)

Regards,

Dex

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4: Ships Galore, Levelled Loot and Balancing, whee!
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

Patch 1.0.4 has been deployed.

Following things have been done:

[list]
[*] Updated Inertia Handling for the Player. Ship should have more weight now
[*] Updated Damage and Turning Values for all NPCs
[*] Updated all Models to use less resources
[*] Updated all Textures to optimize visibility
[*] Updated Loot to have different longevity levels
[*] Updated Target Interface Reticule
[*] Unlocked the Ability to have NPC spawn in all 5 Classes.
[*] All Ships have their Stats rebalanced.
[*] Picking up an Upgrade now gives Audio feedback
[*] Preparations for Minefields have been added
[/list]

Feel free to join the Community Discord here:

[url=https://discord.gg/sbFyqVS]AOTFA Discord[/url]

Next Update - 1.0.5

Regards, Dex

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3: Comets, Phat Lootz and Faction Ownership, Oh my!
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

Patch 1.0.3 has just been sent to Steam

Following things have been done:

[list]
[*] Comets now can spawn and wreak havoc through a system.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2: NPC Traffic, Capital tweaks and literal hellfire
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

Patch 1.0.2 has just been deployed. I hope you enjoy this upgrade again, with the swift and clear fixes.

Following things have been done:

[list]
[*] NPC Traders have started appearing in two flavours.
[*] Updated Animations for Capital Ship Explosions... again.
[*] Even more Code and Performance Cleanup.
[*] Capital Ships now slowly roam the system, leading to occasional capital battles in the system.
[*] Ships now leave a trail of fire behind when they are about to explode
[*] Updated Naming Scheme for Capital Ships
[*] NPC Traders now use Stargates.
[/list]

Feel free to join the Community Discord here:

[url=https://discord.gg/sbFyqVS]AOTFA Discord[/url]

Next Update 1.0.3 will bring you something more... temporary!

Regards, Dex

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1: Navigation, Faction Assignments, Texture Updates
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

Patch 1.0.1 has just been deployed to Steam!
Following things have been done:

[list]
[*] Fixed a critical Error in the Faction War Storyline causing the Client to crash
[*] Updated Animations for Capital Ship Explosions
[*] Updated Capital Ship Textures to look less squishy
[*] Updated Capital Ship Scaling to give a realistical battle chance
[*] Gates now have Banners on each side showing the allegiance of the Faction they belong to.
[*] Gates now Display the Name to the Sector they connect to when close and in view.
[*] Gave Kyle Burnert a better Paintjob for his ship.
[*] Further Code and Performance Cleanup.
[*] Added more hidden Items to discover
[*] Added Groundworks for Temporary Upgrades.
[*] Fixed critical crash in battlefield module on a stalemate.
[*] Trading Cards have been added to the Game.
[/list]

Feel free to join the Community Discord here:

[url=https://discord.gg/sbFyqVS]AOTFA Discord[/url]

I hope you enjoy this update and more features to come soon,

Regards, Dex
